scenarios.expected: Each Request creates one work object of its configured target; paper and conversation retain the documented ownership and reach. Concurrent conversion, archived carried references, and missing required values have supported repair or refusal paths.
scenarios.actual: Work2, AI conversion switches off (the connector was enabled by the contracts-b group; all three Request conversion switches off): 14 browser steps passed. Triage > Convert to contract on R-53 opened the manual dialog directly with Title, Contract type, Priority High, Description (collected Row), Counterparties registry picker with the proposed name, Needed by date picker, the carried Fields, the archived Entity note "DOC-030 inbox Old Holdings Ltd is archived. Pick a live entity to convert.", the empty required Cost centre, Documents tiles for both Request files and Convert to matter instead; no Unverified and no Carries into / Does not carry into lists. Refusals: "Name the contract.", "Pick a live value for DOC-030 inbox Contracting entity.", then "Fill DOC-030 inbox Cost centre — this contract type requires it."; Cancel left it undecided. Changing the Type to NDA showed NDA's Rows and changing back kept the edited Title and typed value. Attach documents staged two files with Document type offered, the remove control took one off, and Convert to contract made exactly one Contract, C-128, with the added file uploaded after creation. C-128: reviewed Title, Type, Priority high, Risk unset, Request Description and Department, one Needed by Key date, Fields with the carried and typed values and the live Entity, Legal Owner Daniel Okafor (not the triage assignee), Business Owner Oliver Grant, team with the Contract Type default person Priya Raman, the Current / Requester switch. Both Request files became root Documents at Version 1 with original bytes, the first primary; comments moved with tiers and paper; original attachment links answered 404 to staff and Portal; the R- address redirected to /portal/contracts/128 with Original request, left Your requests, and Rosa Iglesias was refused. R-54 with the Matter template kept the carried answer over the template default, showed the Region choice default North, No template removed it; with the Entity explicitly cleared and Needed by picked it became M-48 with Title and Priority kept, Risk unset, Daniel as Matter Manager, the Matter section on Overview, Tasks and Key dates from creation in UTC, one Needed by, two Documents without primary, and no Unverified value with Matter preparation off. R-55 re-targeted to Matter showed only Matter Rows, refused "Pick a matter type.", kept the Title through Convert to contract instead and back, and became M-49; Supplier name and Budget note stayed on the Request only. Nadia's competing conversion of R-56 made the dialog say "Somebody else already converted this request." and "It became C-131." with Close; one Contract, and a second convert answered 409. R-57's stale template default was refused as "DOC-030 inbox Region choice: pick one of the options." without deciding; No template made M-50, and a failed added upload showed "Record created. Some documents could not be uploaded." with Continue and Retry failed uploads, which uploaded it. Separate inboxai lab with a local stand-in provider: 10 browser steps passed. With Prepare Matter conversions with AI on, R-37 showed "Conversion draft", "Getting matter ready…", "Working for 2 seconds.", the leave hint, Close and Continue manually; Close left it undecided; the bell item "The Conversion draft for … is ready to review" reopened /inbox/37?convert=matter. The prepared dialog marked Title, Description, Matter cost centre and Adviser name Unverified while carried unchanged values stayed plain; the Description switch showed AI generated / Requester; "Conflicting sources need your review:" listed Region choice; Attachment reading details named the unreadable file. A sparkle opened the saved explanation and Sources; an attachment citation opened the reader above the dialog and Close the document returned with edits intact and no new model call. Discard AI suggestions kept the edited Title and removed untouched suggestions; conversion made M-24, whose empty Record Row Engagement summary then filled in the background with an Unverified value, no progress or retry control, a working sparkle and Confirm. R-38 with Continue manually and a Priority edit during the held record-Row run got no values. With Fill Contract Fields after conversion on, R-39 converted manually to C-37; the Fields header read Running… and the Contract summary Record Row and Risk landed Unverified. With Contract preparation on and broken replies, R-40's draft showed "The AI provider returned a response that did not match the required format. Retry or continue manually." with Cancel, Continue manually and Retry; Retry prepared it, the accepted Cost centre stayed Unverified on C-38, and a failed Analysis run offered Retry Request-context Analysis, which then filled the Row.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

work2 is shared with other DOC-030 agents. Only records named DOC-030 inbox were created; no organisation setting was changed on work2. Development runs before the recorded runs left more DOC-030 inbox Requests and records from Diego Salas, Felix Brandt, Karim Aziz and Lena Vogel; they are not credited.
Requests came from the seeded Business Users Oliver Grant and Rosa Iglesias, not Jonas Weber and Amara Nwosu, to keep the shared sign-in link and submission budgets free for other groups.

Competing resolutions and conversions were written by the other legal role through the lab API while the browser write was held. The people-load failure used an aborted browser request; the failed assignment save and failed document upload used controlled 503 browser responses.

Confirmed the author's limitation: the Convert dialog lists only the destination Form's Rows and does not name answers that stay behind; the stay-behind answers were confirmed on the Request page (R-55, R-63). The author's product bug about DES-059/DES-060 stands.

Confirmed the author's limitation: the Matter record-Row preparation has no progress or retry control. Its Unverified values were observed only on the separate inboxai lab with the stand-in (M-24, M-26), and its no-write path after a Matter edit on M-25 and M-27. On work2, with the switch off, no Unverified values appeared.

AI behaviour was walked with a stand-in provider, not a live provider: answers are fixed fictional citations, and the conflict and failure states were forced through the stand-in's control routes. Changing Type or switching modules with preparation on, the Current / AI generated switch after re-preparation, and Document Version evidence in the doc panel on the record were not exercised.

Value, Our entity, Effective date and term Rows, and a template default refused for a reason other than an invalid option, were not exercised. The Matter templates, Document Versions, comments and Contract analysis guides were not followed.

In the ai phase log, the first run of the record-Row step failed on the script's popover locator (the Matter page names the popover "Unverified value"); walkthrough-ai-record.json re-ran that step on the same Matters and passed. The failed entries are marked superseded.
